Trace, implement and test: 剑指 Offer II 065. 最短的单词编码

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
struct Trie {
    Trie* children[26] = {nullptr};
};

class Solution {
public:
    int minimumLengthEncoding(vector<string>& words) {
        auto root = new Trie();
        for (auto& w : words) {
            auto cur = root;
            for (int i = w.size() - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
                if (cur->children[w[i] - 'a'] == nullptr) {
                    cur->children[w[i] - 'a'] = new Trie();
                }
                cur = cur->children[w[i] - 'a'];
            }
        }
        return dfs(root, 1);
    }

private:
    int dfs(Trie* cur, int l) {
        bool isLeaf = true;
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 26; ++i) {
            if (cur->children[i] != nullptr) {
                isLeaf = false;
                ans += dfs(cur->children[i], l + 1);
            }
        }
        if (isLeaf) {
            ans += l;
        }
        return ans;
    }
};
